title: A Detector-Based Inference Framework for Quantum Theory and Spacetime Geometry
summary: We develop a detector-based framework in which quantum theory and spacetime geometry arise within a common inferential structure. Detector states and a detector kernel assign amplitudes to measurement events, allowing quantum theory to be interpreted as weighting hypothetical configurations consistent with observed detector clicks. Using a Gaussian detector model with phase structure, we show that distinguishability induces an information geometry on detector-state space, described by the quantum geometric tensor.
